## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The invite flow still accepts eight-character passwords, which leaves a signup path outside the new twelve-character policy the description says this change enforces; fix that before merge.

## Changes
The pull request raises `MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH` from 8 to 12 in `app/signup.py` and `app/reset.py` and updates both boundary tests to check lengths 0, 8, 11, 12 and 13. It also adds a one-line `review.txt` file.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/signup.py:1 — correctness — Raise the invite validator's minimum to twelve too — A 10-character password sent through the invite flow is still accepted, because `app/invite.py:1` keeps `MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH = 8`. The description says the PR raises "the minimum in the password validators", but only signup and reset were changed, and `app/invite.py:5` uses the same `len(password) >= MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH` check. — Users who join by invite can set passwords of 8 to 11 characters, which the stated security policy does not allow. — Fix: Set `app/invite.py:1` to 12 and update the parametrize list and expected result in `tests/test_invite.py:6-8` to match the signup and reset tests.
